# IPThing

> Shows your public IP address and the HTTP/TLS details of the connection to this host. No ads, no JavaScript. Browser HTML or curl JSON.

The address labelled IP Address is the TCP or QUIC peer (RemoteAddr). X-Forwarded-For and similar headers are display metadata only and are never trusted as the client IP. The service runs on the public internet with no reverse proxy.

## Pages

- Home (live inspector): https://ipthing.net/
- curl / JSON examples: https://ipthing.net/curl
- IPv6 vs IPv4: https://ipthing.net/ipv6
- Request headers: https://ipthing.net/headers
- TLS / HTTP/3 / JA3 / JA4: https://ipthing.net/tls
- Privacy: https://ipthing.net/privacy
- Aggregate traffic stats: https://stats.ipthing.net/
- Source: https://github.com/jonhadfield/ipthing

## CLI

```
curl https://ipthing.net
curl -4 https://ipthing.net
curl -6 https://ipthing.net
curl -s https://ipthing.net | jq -r .IPAddr
```

Non-browser clients (typical curl Accept: */*) receive pretty-printed JSON. Browser User-Agents, or Accept preferring text/html, receive HTML.
